import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 65;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int m, len;
    static long[] v = new long[N];
    static int[][] vArr = new int[N];
    static class Node {
        int[][] v = new int[35][35];

        Node() {
            for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < v[0].length; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Node multiply(Node b) {
            Node c = new Node();
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                        sum += (long) this.v[i][k] * b.v[k][j];
                    }
                    c.v[i][j] = (int) (sum % mod);
                }
            }
            return c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        m = sc.nextInt();

        v[0] = n;
        len = 0;
        while (v[len] != 0) {
            vArr[len] = (int) (v[len] % m);
            v[len] = v[len] / m;
            len++;
        }

        Node[][] T = new Node[len][m];
        Node[][] s1 = new Node[len][m];
        Node[][] s2 = new Node[len][m + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                T[i][j] = new Node();
            }
        }

        // Initialize T, s1, s2
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    T[i][j].v[m][m] = 1;
                    for (int a = 0; a < m; a++) {
                        if (a != j) {
                            T[i][j].v[a][a] = 1;
                        } else {
                            for (int b = 0; b <= m; b++) {
                                T[i][j].v[a][b] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (j == 0) {
                        s2[i][m - 1] = T[i][m - 1];
                        T[i][j] = s2[i - 1][0];
                    } else {
                        s2[i][j] = new Node();
                        s2[i][j] = multiplyNodes(s2[i][j], s2[i - 1][j]);
                        T[i][j] = multiplyNodes(s2[i - 1][j], s1[i - 1][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            // Build s1[i]
            s1[i][0] = T[i][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                s1[i][j] = s1[i][j - 1].multiply(T[i][j]);
            }
            // Build s2[i]
            s2[i][m] = T[i][m - 1];
            for (int j = m - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                s2[i][j] = T[i][j].multiply(s2[i][j + 1]);
            }
        }

        Node S = new Node();
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            S.v[0][i] = 1;
        }

        int j = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (vArr[i]-- > 0) {
                S = S.multiply(T[i][j]);
                j = (j + 1) % m;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(S.v[0][m]);
        sc.close();
    }

    static Node multiplyNodes(Node a, Node b) {
        return a.multiply(b);
    }
}
